title: The configured Base58 alphabet determines the wire bytes
summary: The swapped Base58 alphabet emitted 221 for two zero bytes followed by one. A fresh decoder recovered those bytes from the literal, and the independent base-58 carry fixture also matched.

change.description: The builder derives its inverse alphabet from the configured 58 distinct bytes. The encoder and decoder also use that alphabet’s zero digit.

notes: 58 is one times 58 plus zero. The leading zero byte adds a separate zero digit before those two positional digits.
